description.value: Ritual Coffeeworks is a community-oriented coffee shop in Prince George, BC, describing itself as a 'third space' for connecting with others, doing remote work, or simply taking a moment to yourself. Located in a commercial unit on 3rd Avenue in the heart of the city, it offers a welcoming urban stop for cyclists passing through the Cariboo and Central Interior region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an operating coffee shop at 101-1085 3rd Ave, Prince George, BC with Copyright 2026 and current hours listed; the 'STATS: Closed' text is almost certainly a real-time open/closed widget captured outside business hours rather than a sign of permanent closure. OSM tags internet_access=yes and internet_access:fee=no, and the website explicitly positions the space for remote work, together providing sufficient evidence to confirm free Wi-Fi. No cycling-specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Ritual' but the website header and copyright footer consistently use 'Ritual Coffeeworks'.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Sa 08:00-16:00) differ from website hours (Mon-Fri 8am-4pm, Sat 8am-3pm, Sun 8am-3pm) — website includes Sunday and shows an earlier Saturday close time.
'STATS: Closed' appears in the fetched page content; assessed as a real-time open/closed widget captured outside business hours, not evidence of permanent closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating coffee shop in Prince George with a live website, current hours, and Copyright 2026; a useful rest stop for touring cyclists moving through the Central Interior.
